create_nih_chest_dataset: create a NIHChestDataset instance to load NIH chest X-ray data with a specified split and labels
get_default_labels: get the default list of 14 chest X-ray finding labels from the NIHChestDataset class
resplit_patient_data: resplit NIH chest X-ray data into train val and test sets using a custom seed and ratios
preprocess_csv_metadata: preprocess the Data Entry CSV to add view position formatting and apply subselect query filters
retrieve_chest_xray_sample: retrieve a chest X-ray image with its labels and metadata by index from the dataset
